cards.title: Lambda to lambda conversion
cards.role: Converts the paper perturbation parameter into the sampled Hamiltonian parameter.

checks.reason: Formula is recorded in the paper method and existing formula check.
Solving Lambda=lambda^2 d/(2 pi) gives lambda=sqrt(2 pi Lambda/d).

checks.reason: Formula is recorded in the paper method and existing formula check.
The code applies the same sqrt(1+lambda^2) normalization.

cards.numerical_form: sample_hamiltonian draws H0 and GOE V, then normalizes by sqrt(1+lambda^2).

cards.title: Two-photon permanent probability

checks.reason: Permanent formula is recorded in the paper method and existing formula check.
The 2x2 permanent reduces to the sum of two products.

cards.numerical_form: conditional_two_photon_distribution computes the squared permanent for all output pairs.

cards.title: Printed Eq. S8 excluded-mass notation trace

source_refs.value: Appendix A defines Y=1-sum_{x in C} p_x, then prints a density proportional to (1-y)^(C-1) exp[-N0(1-y)] in Eq. S8.
The following paragraph calls p_j^cond a ratio involving the Gamma distribution of Y; paper-source/extracted/main.tex:486-501.

cards.role: Records the publication's exact definition and printed density so a fresh reviewer can adjudicate their internal consistency; this card does not decide a paper error.

checks.reason: Both the Y definition and the printed Eq. S8 density are transcribed directly from the frozen TeX source.

cards.numerical_form: Not used by the numerical generator; T004 samples normalized conditional probabilities directly.
open_questions: The author-side record notes that Y is named excluded mass while the printed density is written in 1-y. Whether this is a variable-definition error, a reflected-variable convention, or a prose omission is reserved for fresh independent review.
